title: Contextual Scalarisation Thompson Sampling for multi-objective decisions in public media
abstract: arXiv:2605.31291v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recommender systems may operate under multiple, competing objectives. For example, audience reach, cultural values, public service mandate, and operational constraints must be balanced in editorial decisions of public service media. Existing approaches relying on fixed combinations of objectives or Pareto-based optimisation do not adapt to changing priorities across situations. In this paper, we propose Contextual Scalarisation Thompson Sampler (CSTS), a multi-objective contextual bandit method that learns to weight objectives as a function of the observed context. We evaluate CSTS on real programming data from Radio T\'el\'evision Suisse, the Swiss national broadcaster, showing improved contextual relevance and better alignment with expert curation practices compared to fixed weight and standard contextual bandit approaches.

translated_title: 公共媒体多目标决策的上下文标量化汤普森采样
translated_abstract: 推荐系统可能在多个相互竞争的目标下运行。例如，在公共服务媒体的编辑决策中，必须平衡受众覆盖面、文化价值、公共服务使命和运营约束等多方面因素。现有方法依赖于固定的目标组合或基于帕累托的优化，无法适应不同情境下不断变化的优先级。在本文中，我们提出了上下文标量化汤普森采样器，这是一种多目标上下文多臂老虎机方法，能够学习根据观察到的上下文对目标进行动态加权。我们在瑞士国家广播公司瑞士广播电视台的真实节目数据上对CSTS进行了评估，结果表明，与固定权重方法和标准上下文多臂老虎机方法相比，CSTS提高了上下文相关性，并更好地与专家策展实践保持一致。
tldr: 提出了一种多目标上下文多臂老虎机方法CSTS，能够根据观察到的上下文动态学习目标权重，在瑞士公共媒体真实节目数据上实现了比固定权重方法更好的上下文相关性和专家策展一致性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Contextual Scalarisation Thompson Sampling (CSTS), a multi-objective contextual bandit method that learns to weight competing objectives as a function of the observed context, demonstrating improved contextual relevance and alignment with expert curation practices on real programming data from Swiss public media.
